get_device_information.name: Get device information
get_device_information.description: Query all supported information from an Ultraloq lock over Bluetooth.

set_device_time.name: Set device time
set_device_time.description: Set an Ultraloq lock's clock using Home Assistant's current local time or a supplied ISO timestamp.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Ultraloq lock whose clock should be set.

datetime.name: Date and time
datetime.description: Optional ISO date and time. Leave empty to use Home Assistant's current local time.

set_device_autolock.name: Set device auto-lock
set_device_autolock.description: Configure auto-lock on an Ultraloq lock or send a manual SET_AUTOLOCK payload.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Ultraloq lock whose auto-lock settings should be changed.

duration.name: Time
duration.description: Delay before the lock automatically locks.

door_sensor.name: Door sensor
door_sensor.description: Lock immediately when the door sensor reports closed instead of using timer mode.

manual.name: Manual
manual.description: Optional raw hexadecimal payload. When supplied, it overrides Time, Door sensor, and Enabled.
